name: soia-office-aide
description: Workplace document aide: read-only research across Feishu Wiki, Drive and docs, one-way sync of Feishu knowledge bases into local Markdown, and authorized export, verification and archiving of ProcessOn diagrams.

displayDescription.en: Researches Feishu Wiki, Drive and docs read-only, syncs knowledge bases into local Markdown with source metadata, and exports, verifies and archives ProcessOn diagrams under your authorization.
displayDescription.zh: 以最小权限只读调研飞书知识库与云文档，同步成本地 Markdown，并按授权导出归档图表。

quickPrompts.en: Our team's material is spread across Feishu and ProcessOn. Help me research it read-only and pull a reviewable local copy.
quickPrompts.zh: 团队资料散在飞书和 ProcessOn 上，帮我只读调研一遍，并同步一份可复核的本地副本。

quickPrompts.en: Sync this Feishu knowledge base into local Markdown, keeping the directory structure and source metadata.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个飞书知识库同步成本地 Markdown，保留目录结构和来源元数据。

quickPrompts.en: Inventory my ProcessOn diagrams and export the ones I authorize.
quickPrompts.zh: 盘点我的 ProcessOn 图表，把我授权的那些导出归档。
